name: Test websites and provide usability feedback
reason: Dead worker program. A third-party tracker updated 2025-08-12 states Analysia is no longer available for earning through usability testing; the official domain now carries stale generic testing articles with no verifiable active tester program or current pay terms. Closed/dead programs must be rejected.

name: Complete moderated and unmoderated usability tests
reason: Discontinued/absorbed. validately.com now loads the UserTesting enterprise homepage; no Validately participant route or Validately-specific terms remain. Closed worker programs must be rejected.

name: Complete quick website usability tests
reason: Sheet payout unsupported. Official current customer pricing is roughly $1 per requested testing minute, which contradicts the sheet's '$10 per 10-15 minute test'; no official current worker-pay terms could be found, so the $10-per-unit bar cannot be verified. Reject.

name: Transcribe audio files for various clients
reason: No public worker program. The official homepage is alive and says transcripts are produced by an 'in-house, experienced team,' but there is no public worker application, pay, acceptance, or payout terms. The nine questions cannot be answered from official terms. Reject.

name: Transcribe legal and law enforcement audio
reason: Professional gate + no stated pay. Requires prior multi-speaker/law-enforcement transcription experience, 80 WPM, U.S. citizenship, background check, and specialty equipment; worker reviews report erratic work volume ('no work currently'). Not beginner-accessible and the nine questions cannot be answered from official terms. Reject.

name: Complete captioning tasks for video content
reason: Wrong entity. The current company at this name is a film/TV branded-content production agency, not a public captioning worker platform. No verifiable worker program exists. Reject.

name: Write articles and blog posts for clients
reason: Active company but no verifiable worker program terms. Express Writers remains active under Compose.ly ownership, yet no current public contractor pay rates, openings, acceptance rules, or payout timing could be verified from official sources. Reject when official worker terms are missing.

name: Complete freelance writing assignments
reason: Dead. writerful.com is listed for sale; the claimed freelance-writing platform does not exist. Dead programs must be rejected.

name: Proofread documents with a partner system
reason: Expert gate + below-bar pay + exploitative terms. Requires being a current graduate/postgrad student with 3.5+ GPA OR a graduate degree with 5+ years professional editing experience. Realistic entry pay is $0.50-$1.50 per 100 words (~$5-$15/hr for normal speeds), below the $10 bar; many passers are pushed into a 30-project unpaid 'trainee' program, and workers report $40 fines for missed 'guaranteed availability' shifts. Reject.

name: Edit and proofread academic documents
reason: Program closed. The official apply page states: 'Scribendi's freelance roster is currently full and we are not accepting applications at this time.' Closed worker programs must be rejected.

name: Answer research questions for clients
reason: No verifiable official worker terms. askwonder.com could not be fetched to confirm an active researcher-worker program; available third-party material is stale and mixed (some reports $8-$35 per task with unpaid rejections), so current official pay, acceptance, and payout terms cannot be verified. Reject.

name: Provide virtual assistant services
reason: Professional gate + no guaranteed hours. Bookkeeper roles require a bachelor's degree and 5 years accounting experience; assistant roles require years of professional experience. BELAY states it does not guarantee hours or client assignments, and ramp to full-time takes 6-9 months. Not a beginner method; payment certainty fails. Reject.

name: Work as a virtual assistant
reason: Professional gate. Requires a bachelor's degree plus at least 3 years of recent remote work experience (and 3+ years of paralegal experience for paralegal roles). Professional-staffing job, not a beginner method. Reject.

name: Provide remote customer service
reason: Heavy upfront costs + unpaid training + contractor misclassification litigation. Agents must form their own business (IBO model), pay for equipment, background checks, and certification, with platform fees deducted per paycheck; one arbitrated case showed 44 unpaid days of certification before a $96.12 paycheck. The U.S. Department of Labor has sued Arise over misclassifying 22,000+ agents. Fails clean-money, cost, and payment-certainty bars. Reject.

name: Handle customer support calls remotely
reason: Obsolete brand + no verifiable current official role. Sitel is now Foundever, but the official jobs.foundever.com search results on 2026-09-23 show no current fully-remote US customer-service opening with stated pay/terms (results were Portugal, Canada, Australia, Germany, Egypt, Nicaragua, Costa Rica). The generic 'Sitel' claim is obsolete and official terms cannot be verified. Reject.

name: Provide technical support services
reason: No verifiable public worker program. No official current work-from-home agent application, pay rates, acceptance rules, or payout terms could be verified from official sources. Reject when official worker terms are missing.

name: Moderate online communities
reason: Below-bar/unstated pay + shrinking availability. Worker reviews report pay around $9-$10/hour (below the $10 bar) with monthly payments, and recent reports say project availability has plummeted; current postings state the rate is only 'to be discussed in the interview phase.' No official stated pay meets the bar. Reject.

name: Moderate social media and online content
reason: Obsolete name. eModeration rebranded to The Social Element in 2017; the submitted platform/name is obsolete and no current worker terms were verified. Reject.

name: Provide customer support via chat
reason: No verifiable public worker program. The 'Human Cloud' network exists as a B2B vendor feature, but no official public specialist application, pay rates, acceptance rules, openings, or payout terms could be verified from Simplr's own sources. Reject.

name: Complete AI training micro-tasks
reason: Micro-pay, fails the $10-per-unit bar. Available evidence describes cents-level annotation work (roughly $0.50-$3 per 1,000+ tasks) with a $40 withdrawal threshold. Realistic beginner payout per unit is far below $10. Reject.

name: Complete data annotation micro-tasks
reason: No verifiable worker program terms. Tasq.ai is a B2B annotation platform; no public worker signup, pay rates, acceptance rules, or payout terms could be verified from official sources. Low-value micro-annotation also fails the $10-per-unit bar. Reject.

name: Score standardized tests remotely
reason: Professional gate + intermittent work. Roles require state teaching certification (e.g., currently certified Texas teacher with 3+ years classroom experience); scoring sessions run only 1-2 days every 4-8 weeks. Professional job, not a beginner method. Reject.

name: Provide remote bookkeeping services
reason: Company wound down. Botkeeper announced an orderly wind-down in February 2026; Infinite assets were acquired by Xendoo, which is not the claimed public bookkeeping-worker route. Closed programs must be rejected.

name: Complete freelance development projects
reason: Elite gate. Toptal accepts only the top ~3% of applicants through a multi-week screening (live coding tests, trial projects); some approved freelancers wait 30-60 days for a first match. Senior-professional network, not a realistic beginner path. Reject.

name: Work on freelance development projects
reason: Professional gate. Only ~4 in 100 developer applicants pass the vetting; it is a vetted-developer marketplace with a 160-hour minimum project commitment. Senior-professional network, not a beginner method. Reject.

name: Test accessibility features on websites
reason: No worker program. Bee Line Reader is an active accessibility product, but no official paid user-testing or worker program exists. Reject.

name: Complete data entry tasks
reason: No verifiable worker terms. No official public pay rates, openings, acceptance rules, or payout terms could be verified from Axion Data Services; the role requires prior data entry experience and U.S. citizenship, and compensation is an undisclosed flat rate per document. Reject.

name: Find freelance work across categories
reason: Senior-professional gate. Current listings are senior roles (5+ years experience, degrees, $60-$120/hr for senior engineers, U.S.-only for many). Not a beginner method. Reject.

name: Find creative freelance projects
reason: Professional gate + payment uncertainty. Twine is a marketplace for skilled creatives/developers requiring professional portfolios; a verified G2 review reports a freelancer completing work and never being paid (client non-payment, Twine chasing). Payment certainty fails. Reject.

name: Bid on freelance projects
reason: Uncertain beginner payout + contests are a core platform feature. Contests (prize-based competitions) are built into the platform and cannot be credibly excluded; a brand-new freelancer with no reviews faces fierce global bid competition, so realistic beginner payout cannot meet the bar. Contests exist as a hiring mode per the platform's own official terms, which conflicts with the standing never-contests rule. Reject.

name: Find creative freelance work
reason: Professional staffing agency. Roles require degrees, 3-15+ years of professional experience, and portfolios (e.g., 3+ years design, 15+ years digital marketing for fractional roles). Not a beginner method. Reject.

name: Find marketing freelance work
reason: Professional staffing agency. Roles require 4+ years of professional experience, portfolios, and credentials; it is an executive/creative staffing firm, not a beginner method. Reject.

name: Edit audio files for podcasters
reason: Narrow professional gate + unverified pay. The careers page shows contract audio-editor postings requiring 2+ years experience, a degree (preferred), and fluency in a second language (e.g., Russian, Portuguese); there is no general open intake for beginner audio editors and no stated pay. Reject.

name: Earn as a freelance recruiter
reason: Contingent placement pay, not payment for accepted work. Recruiter earnings are generally contingent on a candidate actually being hired (bounty model); for a beginner without a candidate network, payment certainty fails. Professional/experienced-recruiter gate. Reject.

name: Write resumes for job seekers
reason: Position closed. The official resume-writer page currently states: 'Unfortunately this position is no longer open.' Closed programs must be rejected.
